title: The Blue Bird Sam Built
lines: Sam built a big bird from sticks and glue.
It took him three days to get it right.
He made it blue with a few red dots.
Sam held it up on the school steps.
Then a strong wind blew, and the bird flew!
It went up on the roof of the school.
Sam got a long stick, but it was short.
He could not reach the blue bird at all.
Sam ran in and got a long broom.
He glued the stick to the broom.
That tool was long and it did reach.
Sam got the blue bird back on the steps.
He will keep it in his room.

questions.ask: How long did it take Sam to make the bird?
questions.listenFor: Three days. It is in the second line.

questions.ask: How did Sam get the bird off the roof?
questions.listenFor: He glued his stick to a long broom so it would reach. The stick on its own was short.

questions.ask: Would you have made a bird from sticks? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Ask what they would make instead.
